articles.title: Eli Lilly Stock Jumps as Weight-Loss Pill Enters the Market. What It Means for Novo Nordisk.
articles.mainIdea: Eli Lilly Stock Jumps as Weight-Loss Pill Enters the Market. What It Means for Novo Nordisk.
articles.summary: Barrons.com: Eli Lilly Stock Jumps as Weight-Loss Pill Enters the Market. What It Means for Novo Nordisk.. Eli Lilly stock rose sharply on Wednesday after the Food and Drug Administration approved the company’s oral obesity medication, which will become available through Lilly’s direct-to-consumer online pharmacy this month. Foundayo will be available through U.S. retail pharmacies and telehealth platforms at a later date, Lilly said. Rival Novo Nordisk’s American depositary receipts slipped 0.7%. Related tickers mentioned: LLY, NVO.
